correctness.rationale: For a nonscalar complex 2x2 matrix A0, its full centralizer is span(I,A0) even in defective Jordan case. If every Ai commutes with A0, Ai=alpha_i I+beta_i A0; any amplified similarity forces corresponding Bi affine in B0, reducing all constraints to one similar pair. If some Ai fails to commute, the joint commutant is scalars; each block of W and W^-1 intertwines and their diagonal sum gives I, forcing one nonzero scalar product of opposite-direction blocks and hence an invertible unamplified common X. All amplified W then factor C tensor X; spectral-norm condition number factors. The single-pair 2x2 optimum is invariant via the shifted rank-one nilpotent or normalized involution norm ratio; the lower bound holds at every amplification and is attained by the canonical diagonal intertwiner. One-pair sharpness witness gives Theta_2,q(t)=t.
